Title: 🎯 A Start For the Ages
Text: Barcelona has become the second team to win its first nine matches of a season in the entire history of La Liga, after Real Madrid in 1968/69.

Title: 10 - Lamine Yamal
Text: Lamine Yamal is the first player from Europe's five major leagues to reach 10 assists this season across all competitions.

Title: 11 - Rodri
Text: Rodrigo Hernández is the eleventh player to score for FC Barcelona in LaLiga 2026/27.

Title: 8 - Lamine Yamal
Text: Lamine Yamal has scored eight goals in LaLiga 2026/27, the highest tally by a Spanish player after the first nine matches of his club in a season of the competition since Diego Costa in 2013/14 (eight).

Title: 🔴🔵 BRAVE. CONFIDENT. TOGETHER.
Text: Hansi Flick on whether PSG is an early final or a major test: “It will be a good test for us to see where we stand. I want my team to play with confidence, bravery and togetherness, just as we’ve done in recent matches.” “We’re facing arguably the best team in the world over the last two years. It’s a great opportunity to show our level and see what we can improve. After the match, we’ll know a lot more.”
